text:
An observer of the botched execution of Texas prisoner Reinaldo Dennes this week has said the effects of the lethal injection were like nothing he’d ever seen before.
The execution of Dennes at the Huntsville unit of the Texas department of criminal justice took over an hour as the team managing the procedure struggled to find suitable veins in which to administer the injection to the prisoner.
Journalists and observers reported delays of more than 30 minutes before being able to enter the death chamber where Dennes’ final statements would be read and the execution would take place.
When they were allowed in, Dennes was said to appear docile, his eyes closed and his head pointed toward the ceiling.
Dennes was sentenced to death after being convicted of the 1996 murder of Houston diamond dealer Janos Szucs.
Before the injection was administered, Dennes had been asked by the warden if he had a final statement. He spoke about being “extremely blessed” by the love of “the father” and hoped his family and loved ones “get to know this great gift and great grace of God the father”.
The prisoner did not appear dishevelled and there was no sign of a struggle, according to the Associated Press. However Dennes’ reaction once the lethal injection was administered shocked those in attendance.
Dennes reportedly told the warden overseeing the procedure to: “Go”. However as soon as the procedure began, his demeanor was said to have changed. “The pain!” he exclaimed. “Go! Go!”
For nearly three minutes after Dennes repeatedly moaned, exclaiming: “Take me father! … Take me into your arms! … Take me father!” He occasionally interjected his cries with obscenities, a grunt and then groans.
Dennes then said his right leg was “killing me”, he said, likening the sensation to a cramp. “I don’t think this is normal,” he said at one point.
In previous executions, prisoners have been known to say the lethal drug was hot or cold, that they could smell or taste it, or that it hurt. Dennes’ reaction to the drug was said to be like nothing the reporter in attendance had ever seen.
The procedure was completed at 7.07pm, 63 minutes after he was strapped to the gurney. A minute later, after being examined by a physician, Dennes was pronounced dead at 7.08pm at the penitentiary in Huntsville.
Texas prison officials later said the execution team had difficulty finding suitable veins. Spokeswoman Amanda Hernandez said after repeated unsuccessful attempts – she couldn’t say how many – the technicians found a vein in Dennes’ left foot and another on the left side of his neck that were receptive to the IV needles.
His feet were covered by a sheet and only the right side of his neck was visible to the witnesses.
The injection sites were in line with the prison system’s procedures, Hernandez added. The alternate sites have been used in previous executions; although the need to do so is relatively rare.
Hernandez also suggested Dennes may have been faking, saying he had been complaining about pain from areas where no injections were attempted.
digest_he: הוצאתו להורג של האסיר ריינלדו דנס בטקסס נמשכה יותר משעה לאחר שהצוות התקשה למצוא ורידים מתאימים להזרקת חומר הרעל, עד שמצאו ורידים בכפיו ובצווארו. דנס, שהורשע ברצח משס וונג בשנת 1996, אמר הצהרה קצרה לפני ההליך וביטא אמונה באל. עם מתן הזריקה, תגובתו השתנתה והוא החל לצעוק ולזעוק מכאבים במשך כמעט שלוש דקות רצופות, לעיני עיתונאים וצופים שדיווחו כי לא ראו מעולם תגובה דומה לחומר הניתן. דנס הוכרז לבסוף כמת לאחר 63 דקות מרגע שנקשר למיטת ההוצאה להורג. גורמים בבתי הסוהר בטקסס ציינו כי פעולות הצוות נעשו בהתאם לנוהל, אך הודו כי השימוש באתרים חלופיים הוא נדיר יחסית.
